prompt: Nowadays, more individuals are choosing healthier lifestyles given the fact of not consuming animal products, such as, meat or fish. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this trend.
essay:
Nowadays, many schools require all students to bring their own laptop computer to class to support their learning. This has recently become a widely discussed topic within the education system. Although some people believe that personal laptops create unnecessary complications, I firmly agree that using these devices provides significant educational advantages.

The primary advantage of bringing a personal laptop is that students are already familiar with their own devices, which saves valuable learning time. For instance, when students use a keyboard they are comfortable with, they can type essays faster and take more efficient notes during lectures. Furthermore, having a personal device allows students to easily review their classroom material at home because all their work is stored in one place. This also enables parents to monitor their children's daily progress and stay informed about what they learn in school.

On the other hand, incorporating laptops into the classroom can introduce certain drawbacks. The most notable issue is the risk of screen addiction and sedentary habits. When students spend excessive time staring at screens, they are less likely to participate in physical outdoor activities during breaks. In past decades, children routinely played outdoors, whereas today, constant access to computers often leads to a sedentary lifestyle that negatively impacts their physical health.

In conclusion, despite the risks associated with excessive screen time, I strongly believe that bringing a personal laptop to class is beneficial for students' overall education. However, parents and teachers must work together to limit screen time and ensure a balanced lifestyle.
